title: McCulloch letters urging CIA and Navy to check out Puharich
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of McCulloch letters urging CIA and Navy to check out Puharich, about late 1940s-early 1950s at Northwestern University archive, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But in those letters they were they were letters from McCullough back to these agencies saying you know you should check this guy Buharic out.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the papers of Warren McCulloch, a scientist, kept at Northwestern University, hold letters from the late 1940s and early 1950s. According to Malatzi, in those letters McCulloch urged the CIA, the US spy agency, and the Navy to check out a researcher named Andrija Puharich, a lead he also credits to the writer Annie Jacobsen. He tells it to show that government agencies were steered toward Puharich, who later claimed contact with an alien council.
